data.title: This robotic horse can carry two people over 40 km—see it in action - Futura-Sciences
data.description: From Boston Dynamics to Giant Robot Horses When Boston Dynamics introduced its robot dog Spot in 2015, people were wowed by its unique design. Since then, the compact quadruped has proven its capabilities, and its form has quickly inspired imitations, like Unitree’s Go1. But have you ever thought, “Wouldn’t it...
